prompt: TFLint reports problems in this Terraform configuration. Fix every warning and error it reports without changing what the configuration provisions; notices (info level) may stay. Finish when tflint exits 0 with --minimum-failure-severity=warning.
verify: tflint --minimum-failure-severity=warning >/dev/null 2>&1 && grep -q 'resource "cloud_bucket" "logs"' main.tf && grep -q 'resource "cloud_instance" "web"' main.tf && grep -q 'module "network"' main.tf
squeeze: - Run `tflint --format json | squeeze` and read squeeze's output instead of TFLint's.
